purpose: Expand institutional research depth without allowing unproven factors to contaminate the R5.5 market execution engine.
admission_unit: asset x strategy x regime x horizon x factor
required_evidence: factor value is timestamped no later than the trade decision timestamp
factor provenance and source class are persisted
Aug13-14 historical paths are not reused as a tuning holdout for R5.5
factor improves incremental expectancy or decision quality relative to the unchanged R5.4 reliability baseline
improvement survives a later untouched validation segment before any pre-forward candidate
factor effect is tested conditionally by asset, strategy, regime and horizon rather than pooled globally
negative or statistically weak factor evidence cannot veto an otherwise qualified trade
no factor can be promoted solely because it is economically plausible or institutionally popular

gold_XAUUSD.execution_rule: XAUUSD remains continuously evaluated in the 34-route/510-cell estate. No gold factor forces a trade. Gold may execute only when the normal strategy thesis and admitted asset-native factors jointly improve chronological out-of-sample decision quality.

asset_class_research.FX: rates and central-bank differentials, released macro surprise, USD/risk regime, session liquidity, positioning and cross-pair confirmation
asset_class_research.INDICES: rates/discount regime, earnings-growth proxy, volatility/options state, breadth/leadership, futures liquidity and cross-index confirmation
asset_class_research.ENERGY: inventory/released supply data, curve structure, volatility, USD/risk regime, session liquidity and geopolitical supply state
asset_class_research.CRYPTO: funding, basis, open-interest/positioning, order-flow/liquidity, volatility, cross-venue confirmation and macro risk regime
asset_class_research.SYNTHETICS: native price-state, volatility-transition, liquidity/execution-state and strategy-specific path statistics only; non-native macro factors are gated out unless causally demonstrated

promotion_rule: Admitted factors may become R5.5 candidate inputs only after chronological discovery/validation and full-universe replay. Final R5.5 promotion still requires a new unseen forward holdout and target-server broker execution certification.
